title: baccharis pedunculata
intro: Baccharis pedunculata, commonly known as Pucu or Rio Tigre, is a plant species native to South America, particularly in Argentina, Brazil, and Uruguay. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits in treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Baccharis pedunculata include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory actions, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
